sources.title: DaVinci Resolve 21 Reference Manual
sources.date_or_version: July 2026, DaVinci Resolve 21 (4,400+ pages; macOS key names, Option=Alt, Command=Ctrl on Windows/Linux)

sources.title: DaVinci Resolve 15 Keyboard Shortcuts (file content headed 'Guide - DaVinci Resolve 11 Menus & Keyboard Shortcuts')
sources.date_or_version: Resolve 11 content; used only where noted (quit) and for cross-checks

add_audio_crossfade.note: Adds the standard transition to the selected audio edit only, i.e. an audio crossfade (manual ch. on audio, 'Add Audio Only Transition (Shift-T)').

add_clip_marker.note: Resolve has one Add Marker command: with clips selected and the playhead over them, M marks the clips; with nothing selected it marks the timeline ruler. Shift-M is Modify Marker in Resolve.

add_default_transition.note: Adds the standard transition to selected edit points.

close_project.note: Command exists in the File menu; the manual gives no key for it.

copy_color_nodes.note: Same Copy command; with a node selected in the Node Editor it copies the node.

create_multicam.command: Create New Multicam Clip Using Selected Clips (Media Pool)
create_multicam.note: Command exists (Media Pool context menu); no key given in the manual.

cut_clip.note: Klipp's Cut removes the clips as Delete does (closes the gap: crates/klipp-ui/src/app/clips.rs CutClip). Resolve's Edit > Cut (Ctrl+X) leaves a gap; Ripple Cut closes it.

delete_clip.note: Deletes and closes the gap. Manual is written in macOS keys and says Option=Alt, Command=Ctrl on Windows/Linux; its Mac 'Delete' key is Backspace and 'Forward Delete' is Delete here (the manual's own figure caption names Backspace for the leave-gap delete).

export.note: Klipp's Export opens the render dialog; Resolve's nearest single command is Quick Export (or the Deliver page). No key given in the manual. (Ctrl+E in the old Resolve 11 list was Export Project, a .drp project file, not a render.)

extract_edit.command: Ripple Delete of the marked In/Out range (Forward Delete)
extract_edit.note: Resolve has no separate Extract: with Timeline In/Out set, Forward Delete removes the range and closes the gap. In Resolve ' (apostrophe) is Last Frame of clip. Manual is written in macOS keys and says Option=Alt, Command=Ctrl on Windows/Linux; its Mac 'Delete' key is Backspace and 'Forward Delete'

extract_frame_to_file.command: File > Export > Current Frame as Still
extract_frame_to_file.note: No key given in the manual.

fit_to_window.note: Frames the whole timeline; toggles back to the previous zoom.

import_media.note: Documented on the Cut page ('b) Press Command-I'); File > Import > Media is the shared menu command.

lift_clip.note: 'Delete clip and leave gap (lift edit)'. Manual is written in macOS keys and says Option=Alt, Command=Ctrl on Windows/Linux; its Mac 'Delete' key is Backspace and 'Forward Delete' is Delete here (the manual's own figure caption names Backspace for the leave-gap delete).

lift_edit.command: Delete of the marked In/Out range (leave gap)
lift_edit.note: Resolve has no separate Lift: with Timeline In/Out set, Delete removes the range and leaves a gap. In Resolve ; (semicolon) is First Frame of clip. Manual is written in macOS keys and says Option=Alt, Command=Ctrl on Windows/Linux; its Mac 'Delete' key is Backspace and 'Forward Delete' is Delete her

match_frame_source_to_program.note: 'Match Frame also works in the opposite direction': the same F key, used with the Source Viewer active, moves the Timeline playhead to the matching frame. Shift-F is Full Screen Viewer in Resolve.

multicam_angle_1.note: Cut-and-switch, as clicking an angle in the Source Viewer.

multicam_angle_2.note: Cut-and-switch, as clicking an angle in the Source Viewer.

multicam_angle_3.note: Cut-and-switch, as clicking an angle in the Source Viewer.

multicam_angle_4.note: Cut-and-switch, as clicking an angle in the Source Viewer.

multicam_angle_5.note: Cut-and-switch, as clicking an angle in the Source Viewer.

multicam_angle_6.note: Cut-and-switch, as clicking an angle in the Source Viewer.

multicam_angle_7.note: Cut-and-switch, as clicking an angle in the Source Viewer.

multicam_angle_8.note: Cut-and-switch, as clicking an angle in the Source Viewer.

multicam_angle_9.note: Cut-and-switch, as clicking an angle in the Source Viewer.

new_project.note: No key given in the manual. Ctrl+N in Resolve is File > New Timeline.

next_keyframe.note: Edit page: 'Shift-Apostrophe moves the playhead to the next keyframe to the right'. (Fusion page uses Alt+] instead.)

nudge_clips_back.note: One Resolve command nudges whatever is selected, clip or edit point.

nudge_clips_back_many.note: Resolve's fast nudge is 5 frames by default (customizable in User Preferences); Klipp's is 10.

nudge_clips_forward.note: One Resolve command nudges whatever is selected, clip or edit point.

nudge_clips_forward_many.note: 5 frames by default in Resolve; Klipp moves 10.

play_around_edit.note: Plays pre-roll to post-roll around the selected edit/clip (or the playhead); loops when Loop is on.

prev_keyframe.note: Edit page: 'Shift-Semicolon moves the playhead to the next previous keyframe on the left'. (Fusion page uses Alt+[.)

printer_red_up.note: Numeric keypad 7 after Color > Printer Light Hotkeys is turned on (Ctrl+Alt+`); keypad keys cannot be written in Klipp's notation.

printer_red_down.note: Numeric keypad 4 after Color > Printer Light Hotkeys is turned on (Ctrl+Alt+`); keypad keys cannot be written in Klipp's notation.

printer_green_up.note: Numeric keypad 8 after Color > Printer Light Hotkeys is turned on (Ctrl+Alt+`); keypad keys cannot be written in Klipp's notation.

printer_green_down.note: Numeric keypad 5 after Color > Printer Light Hotkeys is turned on (Ctrl+Alt+`); keypad keys cannot be written in Klipp's notation.

printer_blue_up.note: Numeric keypad 9 after Color > Printer Light Hotkeys is turned on (Ctrl+Alt+`); keypad keys cannot be written in Klipp's notation.

printer_blue_down.note: Numeric keypad 6 after Color > Printer Light Hotkeys is turned on (Ctrl+Alt+`); keypad keys cannot be written in Klipp's notation.

quit.note: The Resolve 21 manual lists the command (Menu Descriptions) without a key; the key is from Blackmagic's older official list (Resolve 11 content), see unverifiable.

ripple_trim_head.note: Moves the In point of the clip at the playhead to the playhead; ripples in Trim mode, resizes (leaves a gap) in Selection mode. Ctrl+Shift+[ (always ripples) is used for trim_in_to_playhead.

ripple_trim_tail.note: Out-point counterpart of Trim Start; ripples in Trim mode.

select_backward.command: Timeline > Select Clips Backward > On All Tracks

select_edit_point.command: Select Nearest Edit Point (V) / Edit Point Type (U)
select_edit_point.note: Klipp's one action selects the nearest edit when none is selected, else cycles its side; Resolve splits that into V (select nearest edit) and U (cycle outgoing/centre/incoming).

select_forward.command: Timeline > Select Clips Forward > On All Tracks

select_track_backward.command: Timeline > Select Clips Backward > On This Track

select_track_forward.command: Timeline > Select Clips Forward > On This Track

set_range_to_clip.note: 'Set In and Out points to fit the current clip at playhead'.

split_at_playhead.note: Ctrl+\ is in the Edit page chapters; Ctrl+B (Timeline > Razor) is stated in the Fairlight chapter of the same manual, as a shared Timeline menu command.

toggle_audio_mixer.note: Manual: panel show/hide shortcuts 'can be assigned using the Keyboard Customization window' (no default).

toggle_before_after.command: Bypass Color Grades and Fusion Effects

toggle_browser_panel.note: Panel toggles have no default key; they can be assigned.

toggle_inspector_panel.note: Panel toggles have no default key. Ctrl+Shift+I in Resolve is File > Import Timeline.

toggle_keyframe.note: Resolve's command only adds; Mark > Delete Keyframe is Alt+].

toggle_keyframe_editor.note: Panel toggles have no default key. Shift+K in Resolve is Play Slow.

toggle_multicam_mode.note: Chosen from the Source Viewer mode drop-down; no key given.

toggle_project_notes.note: No key given. Ctrl+Shift+N in Resolve is File > New Bin.

toggle_safe_areas.note: No key given. Alt+S in Resolve's Color page adds a serial node.

trim_edit_back.command: Nudge One Frame Left (edit point selected)
trim_edit_back.note: Same Resolve command as nudge_clips_back; it rolls/ripples a selected edit.

trim_edit_back_many.note: 5 frames by default in Resolve; Klipp trims 10. In Resolve Shift+[ is Trim Start.

trim_edit_forward.command: Nudge One Frame Right (edit point selected)

trim_edit_forward_many.note: 5 frames by default in Resolve; Klipp trims 10. In Resolve Shift+] is Trim End.

toggle_matte_preview.note: Loose match: Highlight shows the current node's qualifier/window matte over grey. Leave out if only an exact match is wanted.

editor_only.command: Toggle Slip / Slide (Trim mode, clip selected)
